correctness.rationale: Surjectivity of evaluation on the three points in each factor gives rank nine, so there are 2047 nonzero filling forms. On each rational second-factor fiber the cubic restriction of a smooth form is the unique nonzero cubic vanishing at its three rational points; a whole fiber would meet the residual divisor or be repeated, contradicting smoothness. Specifying all three cubics imposes twelve independent affine conditions on the twenty coefficients, giving 256 candidates. An independently written parity enumeration over all masks tested geometric singularity on all four charts by eliminating x from the cubic f=A(y)x³+B(y)x²+C(y)x+D(y). For A≠0 one obtains x²=C/A and AD+BC=0, then eliminates x from f_y by squaring its reduced linear equation. For A=C=0, B≠0 use x²=D/B; a common zero of all four coefficients gives a singular fiber-containing divisor. Univariate gcd tests including excluded denominator roots work over the algebraic closure with no extension cutoff. This gave exactly the frozen 66 masks. A separate substitution/point count in the same independent reproduction yielded the listed reps, orbit sizes, stabilizers and profiles exactly and verified that no XOR of accepted forms was accepted. Integrality follows because positive bidegree in both directions precludes a disjoint union of parallel fibers, the only way nonzero effective components could be pairwise disjoint. Adjunction gives genus six. Adding two fiber-normalized equations cancels each cubic restriction, proving the pencil exclusion directly.
residual_risks: The census is for the stated ordered bidegree on the split quadric, not all abstract genus-six curves or their abstract automorphism groups.
